verdict.summary: Analysing retains a strong Symfony-oriented architecture and substantial established QA infrastructure, but the current candidate is not RC-acceptable: fresh read-only validation now exposes a PHPStan max failure with two return-contract errors, the managed port-8098 runtime is stopped, and the repository remains dirty, three commits ahead of upstream, untagged, and internally inconsistent around Gating configuration and guard retirement.
strengths: Canonical layer scan is green with 186 files, zero duplicate basenames, zero source-domain candidates, and zero InterfaceInterface anomalies.
Symfony standalone smoke boots successfully under PHP 8.4.13 and Symfony 8.1.6.
Repository contains extensive PHPUnit, PHPStan max, schema, Gating, Playwright, migration-parity, and behavioral coverage infrastructure.
The /status endpoint has both kernel-level and Playwright behavioral coverage.
risks: Fresh PHPStan max validation fails with two return-type violations in AnalyticsAnalysingEnvironmentConfigService.
Managed runtime on 127.0.0.1:8098 is stopped and /status currently returns connection refused.
The worktree contains seven changes and is not an immutable release candidate.
The branch is three commits ahead of its configured upstream and HEAD has no exact release tag.
composer.json contains duplicate ../Gating path repository declarations.
The staged deletion of analytics-domain-hygiene-guard.php is not accompanied by fresh proof of equivalent canonical enforcement.
next_actions: Resolve the two PHPStan return-contract errors in AnalyticsAnalysingEnvironmentConfigService and rerun PHPStan max.
Reconcile the duplicate Gating repository declaration and production/development Gating dependency model.
Prove replacement coverage before accepting deletion of analytics-domain-hygiene-guard.php.
Produce a clean immutable candidate, then rerun PHPStan, PHPUnit, Gating, schema parity, and applicable behavioral checks on that exact commit.
Verify the managed runtime only after the candidate is clean; do not accept the stale port-8098 state as runtime evidence.
Synchronize upstream state and create an exact release tag only after all deterministic gates are green.
notes: Repository mutation, Git staging, commit, push, changelog modification, and runtime restart were not performed because execution authority is READ_ONLY.

The supplied deterministic snapshot established branch, commit, dirty state, and missing exact tag; live Console MCP reconnaissance confirmed the branch and seven-entry dirty worktree. fileciteturn0file0L1792-L1824
Fresh Console MCP RC validation returned composer_validate GREEN, lint:canon GREEN, standalone:smoke GREEN, and composer:analyse RED with two PHPStan errors.
Visual evidence: NOT_VERIFIED. No new screenshot was produced because the inspected changes do not constitute a user-observable UI change, and the managed application runtime is currently stopped.
Visual Gallery server itself is healthy.
